description: ACT Government publishes this point inventory of municipal assets in the Australian Capital Territory. Water meters cover irrigation supplies, building supplies, drinking fountains, stream gauges and flow meters. The provider describes attributes for meter number, make and model, asset subtype and ownership. Assets are captured through works-as-executed handover or field audits. Coverage is limited to assets owned or managed by the named ACT government services; private, federal and other directorate assets may be absent. The Socrata catalogue and JSON view metadata are public and free to inspect. The native listing does not state a licence. Caveats: only metadata was inspected, no dataset rows or geometry values were downloaded. Field definitions do not establish field completeness or current asset condition. For infrastructure simulation, meter locations and service categories can locate demand observations and monitored nodes; readings and demand profiles are not supplied by this asset inventory. Related catalogue: ACT Government open data portal.
